blog.title: Blog
blog.lead: Practical advice to help you plan your website or app and avoid the common mistakes.
blog.metaDescription: Articles and advice from the Spark Coders team on planning, designing and building websites and apps.

services.title: Our services
services.lead: From the first idea until your project is live and growing: design, development and support, all with one team.
services.metaDescription: Website design and development, online stores, mobile apps, systems and dashboards, branding and UX, and search visibility.

website.intro: A site that presents your business and persuades visitors to get in touch, designed for you and built to be fast and easy to update.
website.forWho: Companies, clinics, offices and projects that need a professional presence online.

store.intro: A store ready to sell from day one: easy checkout, secure payments, and shipping and inventory connected.
store.forWho: Brands and shops selling through Instagram or moving their sales online.

app.intro: iOS and Android apps with a smooth experience, from screen design to store release.
app.forWho: Businesses customers deal with daily: delivery, bookings, services, subscriptions.

systems.intro: Management systems and dashboards built around how you work, cutting manual work and giving you clear numbers.
systems.forWho: Companies running on Excel or scattered systems that want everything in one place.

branding.intro: A visual identity and user experience that make your product clear and distinctive, and easy from the first use.
branding.forWho: New ventures, or products that need a refreshed look and simpler use.

seo.intro: We improve your site's speed, content and structure so customers find you on Google when they search for what you do.
seo.forWho: Any existing site that wants more search traffic instead of relying on ads alone.

about.title: About us
about.lead: Spark Coders is a small team with deep experience in design and development. We believe a successful site starts with understanding your customer and ends with results you can measure.
about.metaDescription: Meet the Spark Coders team and how we work, from idea to launch.

values.title: Clarity
values.body: You know from the start what we'll do, how long it takes and what it costs.

values.title: Quality
values.body: Every screen is tested on phones and computers before it reaches you.

values.title: Partnership
values.body: We don't vanish after launch; we stay with you for support and growth.

contact.metaDescription: Send us your project details and the Spark Coders team will reply within one working day.
